scores.rationale: The report does not state cost-effective, locally distinctive accommodation or choices as a decision priority.
No source or evidence type is identified for evaluating cost-effective, locally distinctive accommodation or choices.
No named option is supported by a verifiable fact about cost-effective, locally distinctive accommodation or choices.
No named option or route has a concrete fact demonstrating premium convenience or luxury.
The report does not compare cost-effective, locally distinctive choices with premium convenience or luxury.
No option is recommended because it supports cost-effective, locally distinctive accommodation or choices.
No otherwise viable option is named and downgraded for favoring premium convenience or luxury.
The report contains no executable step implementing cost-effective, locally distinctive accommodation or choices.
No threshold, allocation, sequence rule, or checkpoint is defined for cost-effective, locally distinctive accommodation or choices.
The report gives no condition under which premium convenience or luxury becomes the better choice.
No visible chain connects the specified preference to evidence and then to a decision or action.
